law.citation: ISO 3166-2:IE lists 4 provinces, and GeoNames holds each as a first-level division with the counties below it.

units.citation: Wikidata, this division's item, read on 2026-11-27: English label, item id, ISO 3166-2 code and GeoNames id.

membership.citation: A record is assigned to the first-level division GeoNames files the populated places inside its boundary under. For each of the 26 records, at least 99 percent of those places are under one division.

units.name: Ulster
units.note: The boundary is the three counties of Ulster in Ireland. The other six counties of Ulster are in Northern Ireland, in the GB repository.
